name: Inventory Report - Stock Mutation Summary
query:
WITH Aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        sle.item_code,
        
        -- Saldo Awal Qty (sebelum from_date)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s, sle.actual_qty, 0)) AS beginning_qty,
        
        -- Saldo Awal Value (sebelum from_date)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s, sle.stock_value_difference, 0)) AS beginning_value,
        
        -- Mutasi Qty In (di rentang waktu)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND sle.actual_qty > 0, sle.actual_qty, 0)) AS total_in_qty,
        
        -- BARU: Mutasi Value In (di rentang waktu)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND sle.actual_qty > 0, sle.stock_value_difference, 0)) AS total_in_value,
        
        -- Mutasi Qty Out (di rentang waktu, negatif)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND sle.actual_qty < 0, sle.actual_qty, 0)) AS total_out_qty,

        -- BARU: Mutasi Value Out (di rentang waktu, negatif)
        SUM(IF(sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND sle.actual_qty < 0, sle.stock_value_difference, 0)) AS total_out_value

    FROM 
        `tabStock Ledger Entry` AS sle
    WHERE
        sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY
        sle.item_code
),

-- CTE 2: Peringkat untuk mencari 1 transaksi terakhir (untuk Saldo Akhir)
LastTransaction AS (
    SELECT
        sle.item_code,
        sle.qty_after_transaction AS ending_qty_ledger,   -- Saldo Qty dari baris terakhir
        sle.valuation_rate AS ending_rate_ledger,  -- Rate dari baris terakhir
        sle.stock_value AS ending_value_ledger,    -- Value dari baris terakhir
        
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
            PARTITION BY sle.item_code 
            ORDER BY 
                sle.posting_date DESC,
                sle.posting_time DESC,
                sle.name DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM
        `tabStock Ledger Entry` AS sle
    WHERE
        sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
)

-- --- HASIL AKHIR ---
-- Gabungkan data Item, data Agregasi (CTE 1), dan data Transaksi Terakhir (CTE 2)
SELECT
    i.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:250",
    i.stock_uom AS "UOM:Data:80",
    
    -- === 1. KOLOM BEGINNING (dari CTE 1) ===
    COALESCE(agg.beginning_qty, 0) AS "Beginning Qty:Float:140",
    COALESCE(agg.beginning_value, 0) AS "Beginning Value:Float:160",
    
    -- Beginning Rate (dihitung)
    IF(
        COALESCE(agg.beginning_qty, 0) = 0, 0,
        agg.beginning_value / agg.beginning_qty
    ) AS "Beginning Rate:Float:160",
    
    -- === 2. KOLOM MUTASI (dari CTE 1) ===
    COALESCE(agg.total_in_qty, 0) AS "Total Qty In:Float:120",
    COALESCE(agg.total_in_value, 0) AS "Total Value In:Float:140", -- DITAMBAHKAN
    
    COALESCE(agg.total_out_qty, 0) AS "Total Qty Out:Float:120",
    COALESCE(agg.total_out_value, 0) AS "Total Value Out:Float:140", -- DITAMBAHKAN
    
    -- === 3. KOLOM ENDING (dari CTE 2) ===
    
    -- Ending Qty (diambil dari baris terakhir)
    COALESCE(lt.ending_qty_ledger, 0) AS "Ending Qty:Float:140",

    -- Ending Value (diambil dari baris terakhir)
    COALESCE(lt.ending_value_ledger, 0) AS "Ending Value:Float:160",
    
    -- Ending Rate (diambil dari baris terakhir)
    COALESCE(lt.ending_rate_ledger, 0) AS "Ending Rate:Float:160"
    
FROM 
    `tabItem` AS i
-- LEFT JOIN ke data Agregasi
LEFT JOIN 
    Aggregates AS agg ON i.name = agg.item_code
-- LEFT JOIN ke data Transaksi Terakhir (HANYA yg rn = 1)
LEFT JOIN 
    LastTransaction AS lt ON i.name = lt.item_code AND lt.rn = 1
WHERE
    i.is_stock_item = 1
    AND (
        COALESCE(lt.ending_qty_ledger, 0) != 0 
        OR COALESCE(agg.total_in_qty, 0) != 0 
        OR COALESCE(agg.total_out_qty, 0) != 0
    )
ORDER BY
    i.item_name;
